forecast_count.label: Evaluated forecasts
forecast_count.description: Number of eligible held-out forecast windows; windows overlap and are not independent batteries.

mae_ah.label: Forecast error
mae_ah.description: Mean absolute error of the held-out random forest capacity forecast, ten discharge cycles ahead. Lower is better.

rmse_ah.label: Root mean squared error
rmse_ah.description: Root mean squared error; emphasises larger forecast errors.

baseline_mae_ah.label: Baseline error
baseline_mae_ah.description: Mean absolute error when future capacity is predicted to stay unchanged.

improvement_pct.label: Improvement over baseline
improvement_pct.description: Relative reduction in pooled mean absolute error versus persistence. Ratio of aggregate errors, never an average of per-cell percentages.

bias_ah.label: Forecast bias
bias_ah.description: Positive means capacity is overestimated; negative means underestimated.

review_flag_rate_pct.label: Historical review flag rate
review_flag_rate_pct.expression: 100.0 * avg(case when prediction < 1.6 then 1.0 else 0.0 end)
review_flag_rate_pct.description: Fraction of held-out forecast windows below an illustrative 80% of 2 Ah threshold. Not the percentage of fleet vehicles needing replacement.

flag_precision_pct.label: Historical review flag precision
flag_precision_pct.expression: 100.0 * sum(case when prediction < 1.6 and actual < 1.6 then 1 else 0 end) / nullif(sum(case when prediction < 1.6 then 1 else 0 end), 0)
flag_precision_pct.description: Among predicted-below-threshold windows, proportion actually below 1.6 Ah at the target cycle. Null if no flags. Not a safety classifier.
